rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
U.S. agritech product specialist working with ranchers, commercial teams, and product and engineering teams to improve cattle-collar and virtual-fencing products and lead product-development projects.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Ranching experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience leading cross-functional projects or running research trials.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Boulder, CO area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
